name: superpowers
description: Hook-strip fork of superpowers@claude-plugins-official 5.1.0 (MIT, Jesse Vincent — LICENSE alongside). Carries the 9-skill transitive closure that dhx skills invoke by name (/dhx:quick heavy route) or retain for direct invocation: using-git-worktrees, writing-plans, subagent-driven-development, executing-plans, finishing-a-development-branch, requesting-code-review, test-driven-development, verification-before-completion, systematic-debugging. (2026-07-12: receiving-code-review pruned — /dhx:drain inlined its review discipline and no other consumer invoked it. Same day, /dhx:worktree preflight and explain/help debug routing were decoupled from using-git-worktrees and systematic-debugging, but both skills stay — using-git-worktrees is still invoked by the /dhx:quick heavy route above, systematic-debugging as a directly-invocable methodology.) Drops hooks/ (the per-context-window using-superpowers mandate injection, ~1,400 tok) and the 4 skills outside the closure (using-superpowers, brainstorming, dispatching-parallel-agents, writing-skills). Plugin name kept as 'superpowers' so existing superpowers:<skill> references resolve unchanged — do NOT re-enable the official plugin alongside this one (namespace collision). (2026-07-12: descriptions of the 5 chain-internal skills — using-git-worktrees, finishing-a-development-branch, requesting-code-review, test-driven-development, verification-before-completion — narrowed to 'Internal to the chain / not for standalone triggering'; chain invocation is by name so this is behavior-neutral, it only stops ambient self-triggering. Intentional divergence from upstream — do not restore upstream wording.) (2026-07-31: TodoWrite -> TaskCreate/TaskUpdate across executing-plans and subagent-driven-development. CC retired TodoWrite; it is absent from the entire transcript corpus (0 events over 120 transcripts, verified 2026-07-31), so the upstream wording instructed a tool that no longer exists. The subagent-driven digraph node labels were renamed in ALL occurrences (3x TaskUpdate, 2x TaskCreate) because graphviz treats them as identifiers -- a partial rename would silently create orphan nodes. Intentional divergence from upstream -- do not restore upstream wording. Corpus evidence: cross-repo docs/research/2026-07-10-cc-ccs-harness-internals.md Sec 18.)
